title: Gooey
brief: A site by Jakub Antalik, shared link-only. The name suggests gooey/morphing visual effects; unverified from the message text.
caveat: The name suggests gooey/morphing visual effects; unverified from the message text.
details: Liquid Gooey (gooey.jakubantalik.com) is Jakub Antalik's liquid-gooey npm package: a React library for liquid, melting, and merging visual effects built on SVG filters, used for gooey menus, blob transitions, and organic backdrops. The original demo page now shows only a move notice pointing to libraries.dev, where it lives alongside his other UI effect libraries (border-beam, thinking-orbs, metal-fx, img-fx). (Coverage note: the live page shows only a move notice to libraries.dev; library details from web coverage.)
